shellcheck.note: Class A accepts only ShellCheck 0.11.0 (PINNED_SCAN_TOOLS in packages/release/deterministic-scans.mjs; any other version fails TOOL_VERSION). The hosted scans install the checksum-verified 0.11.0 before actionlint; the Mac and Dell managed tool directories are provisioned with the same build by host provisioning.

rustfmt.note: The hosted scans and verify jobs install toolchain 1.98.0 (rustfmt 1.9.0-stable 88d9e12ae1). The scan module otherwise picks the newest rustup toolchain under $HOME, which on an agent profile can be an older rustfmt whose formatting differs; the pre-flight pins this binary and exports it as RUSTFMT.

pnpm.note: The npm rows install with --store-dir pinned to the store node_modules was installed from. The adapter's cleared environment makes pnpm default to <HOME>/Library/pnpm/store, which differs from the workspace's store and makes pnpm demand a modules purge (ERR_PNPM_ABORTED_REMOVE_MODULES_DIR_NO_TTY observed 2026-10-23).
